machine.description: Ultra-high-speed thermosonic ball bonder designed for creating interconnecting micro-wires (18µm - 32µm gold and copper) between die bond pads and leadframe fingers at speeds up to 24 wires/second.
machine.manufacturingProcess: An Electronic Flame-Off (EFO) spark creates a Free Air Ball (FAB) at the tip of the ceramic capillary. The ultrasonic horn clamps the ball onto the die pad under controlled force and 138 kHz ultrasonic acoustic vibration. The capillary loops over to the leadframe stitch, forms the tail bond, and severs the wire.
subsystems: Micro-Ceramic Capillary Tool & Wire Clamp Assembly
Heated Workholder Platen & Forming Gas Manifold (N2/H2 95/5)
Non-Stick On Pad (NSOP) High-Speed Optical Detector

components.name: Ultrasonic Transducer Stack
components.function: Converts 138 kHz electrical drive into mechanical acoustic shearing energy.
components.importantParameters: Acoustic resonance frequency (kHz), vibration amplitude (mm/s), PZT temperature (°C).
components.degradationIndicators: Resonance frequency shift (>2.0 kHz), vibration spike (>2.0 mm/s), thermal runaway.

components.name: Ceramic Capillary Tool
components.function: Guides wire, shapes initial ball bond, and stitches second bond.
components.importantParameters: Hole diameter (µm), tip chamfer angle, capillary wear index (µm).
components.degradationIndicators: Capillary tip erosion, wire drag, golf-ball FAB shape.

components.name: EFO Spark Electrode
components.function: Discharges high-voltage arc to melt wire tail into uniform spherical ball.
components.importantParameters: Spark voltage (V), spark current (mA), arc gap distance (mm).
components.degradationIndicators: EFO firing timeouts, oxidized Free Air Ball (FAB).

components.name: Workholder Heater Block
components.function: Maintains leadframe temperature at 150-220°C for intermetallic bonding.
components.degradationIndicators: Thermal fluctuation, leadframe micro-bouncing during ultrasonic burst.

operatingConditions.recommendedOperatingConditions: Forming gas flow > 0.8 L/min, capillary tip cleaned every 10,000 bonds
operatingConditions.maximumContinuousOperation: 80 operating hours before capillary tool replacement

maintenance.procedureSummary: Remove worn 25µm capillary, install new ceramic tool with torque wrench, run auto-resonance sweep at 138.4 kHz.

maintenance.maintenanceAction: Piezo horn impedance check and ultrasonic calibrator verification
maintenance.procedureSummary: Verify transducer electrical impedance at resonance (< 15Ω) and check acoustic amplitude with laser vibrometer.

degradationIndicators.physicalPhenomenon: PZT crystal polarization decay and thermal decoupling
degradationIndicators.measurableEffect: Vibration spikes from 0.45 mm/s to > 3.0 mm/s
degradationIndicators.degradationSignificance: Causes non-stick on pad (NSOP) and lifted ball bonds

degradationIndicators.physicalPhenomenon: Internal dielectric loss and heat dissipation loss
degradationIndicators.degradationSignificance: Shifts mechanical resonance frequency outside generator lock range
